Therefore, the advantages of followership allowed Gotō to put the Taiwan Government-General on a scientific footing from its inception. In Yao’s account, however, the censuses and LTR were punitive, and not

in the sense Hannah uses the term. Yao rightly points out that accurate statistical data render an alien population visible, knowable, and to some extent manageable for outsiders by representing it in “combinable, mobile and stable” units (borrowing from Bruno Latour).
On the other hand, Yao asserts that these expensive and scientific instruments were effective because they aided the government in hunting down rebels.

He also equates “capitalism” with organized theft by noting that land registration made Taiwan’s real estate available for confiscation by Japanese corporations after the hidden acreage was exposed in the cadastres.
In these two instances, systematic and comprehensive knowledge was weaponized for naked exploitation.
zh: 毋宁说，日本是在 1890 年代进入帝国角力场的，那时统计学在欧洲终于已成为治国的基础。因此，后发者的优势使后藤得以从一开始就把台湾总督府置于科学基础之上。然而在姚的记述中，普查与地税改革是惩罚性的，而非汉纳所用意义上的治理术式的。姚正确地指出，准确的统计数据通过把一个异族人口表征为“可组合、可移动而稳定”的单位（借用布鲁诺·拉图尔〔Bruno Latour〕的说法），使外部人得以看见、认识并在某种程度上管理它。
另一方面，姚断言这些昂贵而科学的工具有效，是因为它们协助政府追剿叛乱者。
他还把“资本主义”等同于有组织的盗窃，指出土地登记使先前瞒报的土地面积显现在地籍上，让日本公司得以没收台湾的地产。
在这两个例子中，系统而全面的知识被武器化，用于赤裸裸的剥削。

en: In contrast, Ka Chih-ming has analyzed this same land reform program as a

undertaking. For Ka, the purpose of Gotō’s land reform was only in part to increase the government’s tax yield by registering more land. It also served to cement a TGG class alliance with Taiwan’s smallholders against absentee landlords who collected “small rents” and then forwarded “big rents” to the capital (after skimming). According to Ka—and this echoes the circumspection with which U.S. and Japanese land surveys proceeded in noncolonized spaces—cultivators cooperated with the cadastres in exchange for fee-simple titles to their land. Moreover, the Taiwan Government-General could reallocate these titles thanks to a large buy-off from absentee landlords—paid for by funds raised on the bond market in Japan.
zh: 相比之下，柯志明（Ka Chih-ming）把同一项土地改革工程分析为一项治理术事业。对柯而言，后藤土地改革的目的只有一部分是通过登记更多土地来增加政府税收。它还有助于巩固总督府与台湾小农的阶级联盟，以对抗那些收取“小租”、然后（在揩油之后）向都城转缴“大租”的不在地地主。据柯所言——这也呼应了美、日土地调查在非殖民化空间推进时的审慎——耕作者配合地籍调查，以换取对其土地的完全所有权状。此外，总督府之所以能重新分配这些权状，得益于向不在地地主支付大笔赎买款——其资金来自在日本债券市场上筹得的款项。

en: From a fiscal perspective, Gotō’s gambit worked. From 1905 onward, Taiwan no longer required subsidies from Tokyo and became exceptional in the annals of Japanese colonialism by becoming a boon, rather than a drain, on Japan’s national economy.

Ka writes, “With order restored and revenues ensured through deficit financing, the administration implemented a number of measures to increase production and expand the market: a thorough land cadastral not only revealed tax evasion but greatly facilitated the subsequent reform that created a modern private land ownership system. The land survey and reform guaranteed private property rights, facilitated the effective use of land, and provided incentives to increase production for the market.”
zh: 从财政视角看，后藤的这一着棋奏效了。从 1905 年起，台湾不再需要东京的补贴，并在日本殖民主义的编年史中成为例外——它开始给日本国民经济带来收益，而非消耗其财力。
柯写道：“随着秩序恢复、收入通过赤字财政得到确保，行政当局推行了一系列措施以增加生产、扩大市场：彻底的土地地籍调查不仅揭露了逃税，还极大地便利了随后创立现代私有土地所有权制度的改革。土地调查与改革保障了私有产权，便利了土地的有效利用，并为增加面向市场的生产提供了激励。”

en: Anticipating Ka’s analysis by many decades, the 1906

exclaimed that the “success of [Japanese] colonial policy in Formosa is conclusively demonstrated in the Revenue Column.... The item of ‘Subsidies from Central Government’ that was steadily diminishing finally disappeared...”

W. G. Beasley, also noting the parallel between Japan’s 1870s and 1880s reforms and Gotō’s early twentieth-century expenditures in Taiwan, concluded that the bundle of projects reviewed above had secured “financial stability which... made it possible to meet budget deficits by floating bonds, placed with a newly formed Bank of Taiwan.”
zh: 早在柯的分析之前数十年，1906 年的《日本年鉴》便欢呼：“[日本]在福尔摩沙殖民政策的成功，在财政收入栏中得到了确凿证明……‘中央政府补贴’这一项稳步缩减，终于消失……”
W. G. 比斯利（W. G. Beasley）同样注意到日本 1870、1880 年代改革与后藤二十世纪初在台湾开支之间的平行关系，得出结论：上文审视的那一组工程确保了“财政稳定，它……使通过发行债券来弥补预算赤字成为可能，这些债券由新成立的台湾银行认购”。

en: This quantitative yardstick for success—achieving black-ink balances on regularly scheduled budgets—represents the type of
rationality well articulated by Max Weber in his landmark study

children: The Protestant Ethic and the Spirit of Capitalism

en: . Weber’s linked concepts of quantification and continuous renewal resonate strongly with contemporary governmental projects in colonial Taiwan. Weber writes:
zh: 这种衡量成功的量化标尺——在定期编制的预算中实现盈余——代表了马克斯·韦伯（Max Weber）在其里程碑式研究《新教伦理与资本主义精神》中充分阐述的那种治理术理性。韦伯把量化与持续更新联系起来的概念，与殖民台湾同时代的治理术工程强烈共鸣。韦伯写道：

en: …capitalism is identical with the pursuit of profit, and forever

profit, by means of continuous, rational, capitalistic enterprise. For it must be so: in a wholly capitalistic order of society, an individual capitalistic enterprise which did not take advantage of its opportunities for profit-making would be doomed to extinction.
zh: ……资本主义等同于通过持续的、理性的资本主义经营去不断追求利润、使利润持续再生。因为必定如此：在一个完全资本主义的社会秩序中，一家不利用获利机会的资本主义企业，注定要灭亡。

en: …The important fact is always that a

children: calculation of capital in terms of money

en: is made, whether by modern book-keeping methods or in any other way....

children: Everything is done in terms of balances

en: : at the beginning of the enterprise an initial balance,

children: before every individual decision a calculation to ascertain its probable profitableness, and at the end of a final balance to ascertain how much profit has been made

zh: ……重要的事实始终是：以货币为单位对资本进行核算，无论采用现代簿记方法还是任何其他方式……一切都以账目核算为依据：经营之初作期初核算，每次决策前测算可能的收益，经营结束时作期末结算以确定赚取了多少利润。

en: This passage, on the one hand, reflects the “eat or be eaten” worldview of a number of Meiji intellectuals and statesmen in the 1890s. For example, influential author, public intellectual, and publisher Tokutomi Sōhō, who came to see Japanese imperialism as a means of national survival at century’s turn,
would have assented to substituting “nation” for “enterprise” in Weber’s quotation: nations that do not compete successfully
zh: 这段文字一方面反映了 1890 年代若干明治知识分子与政治家“要么吞并别人，要么被人吞并”的世界观。例如，有影响力的作家、公共知识分子与出版人德富苏峰（Tokutomi Sōhō）在世纪之交逐渐把日本帝国主义视为民族生存的手段，
他会赞同在韦伯的引文中以“国家”替换“企业”：在竞争中失利的国家注定灭亡。

en: Weber’s formulation also encapsulates a core principle of governmentality in Taiwan under Japanese rule. Beginning with the LTR and the census, the Taiwan Government-General quantified human, environmental, and built assets in the colony, and more importantly, it set and recalibrated policy based on income and expenditure

. As Hannah points out, a governmental state relies upon statistical record keeping and computation to manage its heterogeneous resources and budget for multiyear projects. In the competitive imperial setting, failure to balance the colonial budget portended scrutiny from the Diet, which held the purse strings of the military and supplementary budgets for the Taiwan Government-General. Therefore, Weber’s foregrounding of capitalism’s

commitment to positive balances captures the spirit of capitalism as an ethos but also isolates a distinctive feature of statecraft in the postdynastic era. In this dispensation, national expressions of public power underwrote territorially aggrandizing war machines. National militaries, as income-starved institutional behemoths, not only competed against each other but also competed with domestic spending projects that sustained the public power presupposed by militarized states.
zh: 韦伯的表述也概括了日本统治下台湾治理术的一条核心原则。从地税改革与普查开始，台湾总督府量化了殖民地的人口、环境资源与人工设施；更重要的是，它依据收支预测来设定并重新校准政策。正如汉纳所指出的，治理术国家依赖统计记录与计算来管理其异质资源、为多年期工程编制预算。在竞争性的帝国环境中，殖民地预算未能平衡，预示着来自帝国议会的审查——议会掌握着总督府军事与追加预算的钱袋。因此，韦伯强调资本主义以持续取得盈余为目标，既捕捉了作为一种精神气质的资本主义精神，也分离出后王朝时代治国术的一个独特特征。在这一安排下，按全国规模组织起来的公共权力，为扩张领土的战争机器提供了支撑。各国军队作为不断需要财政投入的庞大机构，不仅彼此竞争，还与那些维系着军事化国家所预设之公共权力的国内开支工程竞争。

en: Weber’s contemporary Takekoshi Yosaburō issued a book-length encomium to Gotō Shinpei and Japanese rule in Taiwan the same year that

first appeared. Takekoshi articulated the governmental ethos in his stout defense of the embattled government-general in Taiwan. In 1904 he wrote, “If the trade [between Taiwan and Japan] continues to grow as it has done during the last six of seven years, Japan will by about the year 1910 have received back an equivalent of all the subsidies [to the Taiwan Government-General], together with the interest upon them. From that time

children: Japan will have reached the goal of colonial enterprise

en: , and be able to look to her colony for substantial support.”
zh: 韦伯的同时代人竹越与三郎（Takekoshi Yosaburō）在《新教伦理》首次出版的同一年，出版了一部专门著作，赞美后藤新平与日本在台湾的统治。竹越在其对台湾那个处境艰难的总督府的有力辩护中，阐述了治理术的精神气质。1904 年他写道：“如果[台日之间的]贸易像过去六七年那样持续增长，日本到大约 1910 年就将收回相当于全部[给总督府的]补贴及其利息。从那时起，日本将达成殖民经营的目标，并能够指望其殖民地提供实质性的支持。”

en: Based on his own projections, the economic historian Takekoshi inserted a table that projected TGG annual income, expenditures, public loans (principal plus interest), and a positive overall balance for the years 1903 through 1922. Unsurprisingly, each year cost more than the previous one.
zh: 基于他自己的预测，经济史家竹越插入了一张表格，预测总督府 1903 至 1922 年各年的年度收入、支出、公债（本金加利息）以及总体正结余。不出所料，每一年的花费都比前一年更多。

en: In another example of Weberian rationality at work in colonial Taiwan, TGG councilor Mochiji Rokusaburō issued his famous “opinion paper on the Aborigine problem” (
) in December 1902. With an eye to the bottom line, Mochiji declared that the “savage-territory problem” (
) was, strictly speaking, a land management problem. As peoples who did not submit to the Qing, the “savages” (
) were not covered in the articles of the Treaty of Shimonoseki that formally ceded Taiwan to Japan. Moreover, Taiwan’s

(savage) population lacked recognizable organs of government and therefore stood outside the rules of civilized warfare and diplomacy. As Mochiji put it, “sociologically speaking, they are indeed human beings (
), but looked at from the viewpoint of international law, they resemble animals” (dōbutsu no gotoki mono).
zh: 作为韦伯式理性在殖民台湾运作的另一个例证，总督府参事官持地六三郎（Mochiji Rokusaburō）于 1902 年 12 月发表了他著名的《关于蕃政问题的意见书》（Bansei mondai ni kansuru ikensho）。着眼于最终的收支结果，持地宣称“蕃人蕃地问题”（banjin banchi mondai）严格说来是一个土地管理问题。作为不曾臣服于清朝的民族，“蕃人”（banjin/seibanjin/genjin）未被涵盖在正式把台湾割让给日本的《马关条约》条款之内。此外，台湾的生番（seiban）人口缺乏可辨认的政府机关，因此处于文明战争与外交规则之外。正如持地所言，“从社会学上说，他们确实是人类（jinrui），但从国际法的观点看，他们类似于动物”（dōbutsu no gotoki mono）。

en: Mochiji reasoned that, insofar as “savage territory” could be made to pay for the expenses of punitive expeditions and policing, they would be launched. But if expeditions were sent simply for the purpose of revenge or a display of dominance, Mochiji argued that they should not be undertaken.
Accordingly, the military expeditions targeted the camphor-rich north and left the south mostly untouched. Mochiji here displayed a clear aversion to
(in Foucault’s sense) and showed himself ever the rational bureaucrat.
zh: 持地推论：只要“蕃地”带来的收入足以支付惩罚性远征与警务开支，这些行动就会发动。但如果远征纯粹出于复仇或炫耀支配的目的，持地主张就不应进行。
因此，军事远征瞄准了盛产樟脑的北部，而基本未触动南部。持地在此表现出对惩罚（福柯意义上的）的明确厌恶，并显示自己始终是一个理性的官僚。

en: Takekoshi added urgency to Mochiji’s plan a year later with the plea that “time was running out” for a solution to the “problem of the savages.” He wrote that the militarization of Japanese-Atayal relations “does not mean that we have no sympathy at all for the savages. It simply means that we have to think more about
45,000,000 sons and daughters than about the 104,000 savages.”
Takekoshi thereby embraced home-island Japanese as “sons and daughters” while banishing indigenes from the national family.
zh: 一年后，竹越为持地的计划增添了紧迫感，他恳求说，解决“蕃人问题”的“时间已经所剩无几”。他写道，日本与泰雅人关系的军事化“并不意味着我们对蕃人毫无同情。它只意味着，我们必须更多地考虑我们四千五百万儿女，而非那十万四千蕃人。”
竹越由此把本土日本人拥抱为“儿女”，同时把原住民逐出了民族家庭。

en: Thereafter, the Taiwan Government-General and the Tokyo government dribbled out funds to cobble together remnant Qing private armies and expand the police force in order to secure lucrative areas of camphor production. It took the political clout of fourth governor-general Sakuma Samata (1906–15), a hero of the 1874 invasion of Taiwan, to pry the lid off the imperial treasury. Drawing upon connections to Prime Minister Katsura Tarō and father of the conscript army Yamagata Aritomo, and with the Meiji emperor’s blessing, Sakuma secured a whopping fifteen million yen, in 1909, for a five-year “big bang” spending program to solve the “aborigine question” once and for all.
zh: 此后，台湾总督府与东京政府零星拨出资金，把清治时期遗留下来的几支私人武装组织起来、扩充警察力量，以确保有利可图的樟脑产区。要撬开帝国国库的盖子，靠的是第四任总督佐久间左马太（1906–15 年在任）的政治影响力——他是 1874 年侵台战争的英雄。凭借与首相桂太郎、以及征召军队之父山县有朋的关系，又得到明治天皇的支持，佐久间于 1909 年争取到高达一千五百万日元的款项，用于一项五年“大爆炸”式开支计划，以一劳永逸地解决“蕃人问题”。

en: While the scale, ambition, and cost of Sakuma’s “five-year plan to control the aborigines” was commensurate with the 1873–76 LTR in Japan and the 1898–1905 Gotō spending package in Taiwan, its rationale was not quite the same. In the vein of these early programs, the idea was to create conditions for future wealth accumulation with a large initial investment. But in this case, the human beings in the targeted area were not considered sources of labor power or entrepreneurial skill but were seen instead as obstacles (unless they could be mobilized to subdue other indigenes). There was no attempt here to instantiate the virtuous circle of governmentality. Therefore, Sakuma’s five-year plan, and the TGG policies regarding indigenes more generally, adopted a punitive and
inflected rationality of statecraft, to the exclusion of
concerns.
zh: 尽管佐久间“五年理蕃计划”的规模、雄心与成本，与日本 1873–76 年的地税改革及台湾 1898–1905 年后藤开支方案相当，其理据却不尽相同。沿袭这些早期工程的路数，其想法是以一笔巨大的初始投资为未来的财富积累创造条件。但在这个案例中，目标区域里的人不被视为劳动力或经营才能的来源，反而被看作障碍（除非他们能被动员去制服其他原住民）。这里没有试图确立治理术的良性循环。因此，佐久间的五年计划，以及总督府关于原住民的更一般政策，采纳了一种惩罚性的、带生命政治色彩的治国理性，而把规训考量排除在外。

en: This was the crux of the matter: typically, in a nation-building context, discipline precedes or coincides with governmentality. However, in a colonial situation, wherein the “natives” (in Bayly’s sense of the term) are not reckoned as a potential source of labor but rather as impediments to resource extraction, discipline is—by the yardstick of governmental calculations—wasteful. Foucault’s notion of “biopolitics”
is operative here.
zh: 这正是问题的关键：通常，在民族建构的语境中，规训先于治理术或与治理术同步。然而，在殖民情境中，“土著”（贝利意义上的）不被算作潜在的劳动力来源，反而被视为开采资源的阻碍，于是规训——按治理术核算的标尺——是浪费。这里可以用福柯的“生命政治”概念来解释。

en: Sabine Frühstück’s account of the “modern health regime” in Meiji Japan illustrates the positivities of biopower. Her study analyzes state initiatives to “force a population to be healthy.” Several biopolitical projects, involving vital statistics, the regulation of sex, and government attention to nutrition, exercise, and inoculation, improved Japan’s racial stock so it could stand up to the West and compete in the international arena.
This ensemble of state interventions, many coterminous with the LTR of 1873–76, was aimed at building a healthy conscript army and industrial labor force.
zh: 萨宾娜·弗吕斯蒂克（Sabine Frühstück）对明治日本“现代卫生体制”的记述，例示了生命权力的肯定性面向。她的研究分析了国家“强制民众保持健康”的种种举措。若干生命政治工程——涉及生命统计、性的管制、以及政府对营养、锻炼与接种的关注——改善了日本的种族素质，使其能与西方抗衡、在国际角力场中竞争。
这一整套国家干预（许多与 1873–76 年地税改革同期）旨在培养体格健康的征兵人群与产业劳动力。

en: However, like the LTR, the regime of hygiene aimed to improve national power, not individual health and wealth. As many farmers were dispossessed by land reform, the health of state-regulated military prostitutes was sacrificed for the general health of the body politic. Turned outward or against internal Others, then, a biopolitical regime marks out subpopulations as expendable in the name of the greater good. Fujitani and Achille Mbembe follow Foucault by insisting that arrogating the power to sustain life entails the assertion of a right to extinguish it. This duality has been referred to as “necropolitics.”
zh: 然而，与地税改革一样，卫生体制旨在增强国力，而非个体的健康与财富。正如许多农民因土地改革而丧失土地，受国家管制的军妓的健康，被牺牲给了政治体的总体健康。于是，当生命政治体制转向外部、或转向内部的“他者”时，它便以更广泛的公共利益为名，把部分人口视为可以牺牲。藤谷隆与阿希尔·姆本贝（Achille Mbembe）沿用福柯，坚持认为：把维系生命的权力据为己有，也就意味着主张一种熄灭生命的权利。这种二元性被称为“死亡政治”。

en: Patrick Wolfe’s analysis of the race politics in settler societies emphasizes this point. In North America, he writes, constituting the black race as a population and then nurturing its demographic resilience (partly through the legal fiction of the “one-drop rule”) had a biopolitical logic: labor-pool management. On the other hand, the connected project of Indian removal (through both physical removal and the legal fiction that “mixed blood” Indians were, in fact, not indigenes) had a different economic logic: the land inhabited by indigenes was worth more, calculated in terms of cash value, if Indians could be removed.
zh: 帕特里克·沃尔夫（Patrick Wolfe）对定居者社会种族政治的分析强调了这一点。他写道，在北美，把黑人种族构造为一个人口、再维持这一人群的延续（部分依靠“一滴血规则”这一法律拟制），其生命政治逻辑是管理劳动力来源。另一方面，与之相连的排除印第安人的政策（既把人实际迁走，也借法律拟制否认“混血”印第安人的原住民身份），则有一种不同的经济逻辑：若能把印第安人迁走，原住民所居的土地按现金价值计算就更值钱。

en: Importantly, in this model, racism creates races—not the other way around. Extenuating circumstances may even impel biopolitical regimes to reverse race-based policies in the name of self-preservation. In Takashi Fujitani’s analysis of ethnic management during the Pacific War, the demands of mobilization pushed the Japanese and American regimes of the 1940s to transition from vulgarly to politely racist outlooks in the name of national security. As Japanese-Americans in the United States and Koreans in the Japanese Empire were identified as sources of labor and fighting power, each regime sought to inculcate that hallmark of discipline, the spirit of voluntarism, among formerly excluded populations. The shift to polite racism and the new emphasis on disciplinary measures such as compulsory assimilation programs aimed at the “conduct of conduct” announced a redefinition of marginalized communities in terms of cultural capacities or peculiarities, rather than as biologically defined Mendelian populations.
zh: 重要的是，在这个模型中，是种族主义创造了种族——而非相反。情势的变化甚至可能迫使生命政治体制以自我保存的名义逆转基于种族的政策。在藤谷隆对太平洋战争期间族群管理的分析中，动员的需求推动 1940 年代的日、美两国体制，以国家安全的名义从粗鄙种族主义的观点转向礼貌种族主义的观点。当美国的日裔与日本帝国的朝鲜人被认定为劳动力与战斗力的来源时，每个体制都力图在先前被排除的人口中培育规训的标志，也就是主动参与的精神。向礼貌种族主义的转变，以及对诸如以“引导行为”为目标的强制同化方案等规训措施的新强调，宣告了把边缘社群重新界定为文化能力或文化特性的载体，而非生物学上定义的孟德尔式人群。

en: Leo Ching has made a related argument regarding Taiwan’s indigenes in the 1930s and 1940s. In Ching’s analysis, a combination of alarm over the Wushe Rebellion and wartime mobilization requirements pushed the Taiwan Government-General to imagine the former “savages” (
) as the Formosan Aborigines (
). This new politely racist rhetoric did not entail equal treatment or the end of exploitation, but it portended a shift in administrative rationality. Henceforth, the
would not be formally excluded with the vulgarly racist epithet
. They would instead be targets of disciplinary ministrations aimed at a particular kind of subject formation, one defined by a willingness to die for the emperor.
Huang Chih-huei’s study of the

volunteers who claimed to have exhibited even more “Japanese spirit” than their home-island officers in the Philippines campaigns of 1943 and 1944 stands as a testament to the efficacy of “imperial subjectification” among some indigenes in Taiwan.
zh: 荆子馨（Leo Ching）就 1930、1940 年代台湾原住民提出了一个相关论证。在荆的分析中，雾社起义引起的震动与战时动员需求的结合，推动台湾总督府把昔日的“生蕃人”（seibanjin）想象为高砂族（Takasagozoku）。这种新的礼貌种族主义修辞并不意味平等待遇或剥削的终结，但它预示着行政理性的转变。从此，高砂族不再被以粗鄙种族主义的蔑称“蕃人”（banjin）正式排除。此后他们成为规训措施的对象。这些措施意在塑造一种甘愿为天皇赴死的臣民主体。
黄智慧（Huang Chih-huei）对高砂族义勇队的研究——这些人在 1943、1944 年菲律宾战役中声称表现出比带领他们的日本本土军官更多的“日本精神”——证明了“帝国臣民化”在台湾部分原住民中的效力。

en: This book argues that “imperial subjectification” among indigenes can also be understood as an indigenization movement. While Ching’s chronology and analysis are persuasive as a two-stage model to chart the mechanisms and meanings of the shift from vulgar to polite racism in TGG policy, its emphasis on the ideational aspects of citizenship to the exclusion of its legal-economic bases leaves room for some debate.
zh: 本书论证，原住民中的“帝国臣民化”也可以被理解为一场原住民化运动。荆的年代划分与分析作为一个两阶段模型，用以勾勒总督府政策中从粗鄙到礼貌种族主义之转变的机制与意义，是有说服力的；但它强调公民身份的观念面向、而排除其法律—经济基础，这留下了若干争论的余地。

en: The Taiwan Government-General’s assimilation campaigns were preceded by the multistage trading-post and guardline projects. During the Kodama and Sakuma eras (1898–1915), northern tribes were the expendables in the government-general’s
calculus. These punitive and often bloody campaigns encircled erstwhile borderland “natives” (in Bayly’s sense) with administered territories, reconfiguring their homelands as an ethnic enclave.

While they were regarded as “savage,” and governed largely through the negative techniques of sovereign power, as objects of biopolitical management they were sequestered, “censused, mapped, and museumed.”
zh: 总督府的同化运动之前，是多阶段的贸易站与隘勇线工程。在儿玉与佐久间时代（1898–1915），北部部落是总督府生命政治核算中的可牺牲者。这些惩罚性的、往往血腥的战役，用被行政管理的领土包围了昔日边疆的“土著”（贝利意义上的），把他们的家园重新配置为一个族群飞地。
当他们被视为“野蛮”、并主要通过主权权力的否定性技术来统治时，作为生命政治管理的对象，他们被隔离起来，“被普查、被测绘、被博物馆化”。

en: As “specially administered” subjects, the Taiwan Government-General positioned indigenes as exterior to the more intensively disciplined and governmentalized territories governed by
(mutual-surveillance and tithing organizations) in “regularly administered” Taiwan.

From 1898 through 1902, the government-general revived the old Qing-period system of mutual responsibility and tithing as an efficient mechanism for registering, policing, and mobilizing a Han labor pool. By 1920, the surface of “normally administered Taiwan” was covered with
districts.

These had all been subject to land markets and taxation and were highly commoditized as integral parts of the imperial political economy. However, negatively defined indigenous territory, by 1920, was already “public land” and excluded from the
system. By the time the imperial subjectification campaigns of the 1930s were launched, access to the indigenous territory by outsiders had been suppressed by a permit system for three decades.
zh: 作为“特别行政”的臣民，总督府把原住民置于“普通行政”台湾那些通过保甲（邻里互相监督、以十为单位编组的制度）施以更密集的规训与治理术的地区之外。
从 1898 到 1902 年，总督府恢复了清代旧的连带责任与以十为单位编组的制度，作为登记、警务与动员汉族劳动力池的高效机制。到 1920 年，“普通行政台湾”的表面已布满保甲区。
这些区域都已纳入土地市场与征税，并作为帝国政治经济的组成部分而高度商品化。然而，以排除方式划定的原住民领土，到 1920 年已是“公有地”，并被排除在保甲体系之外。到 1930 年代帝国臣民化运动发动之时，外人进入原住民领土已受许可制限制长达三十年。

en: Against this backdrop, the imperial subjectification policies of the 1930s were implemented through a new generation of indigenous youth corps (

). These corps leaders had attained adulthood under Japanese rule in an ethnic enclave. As the government-general mobilized these corps through drill, parade, song, schools, panindigenous gatherings, and finally military recruitment, it solidified the standing of the indigenous territory as a separate entity, or what I have termed a “second-order geobody.” Therefore, the “imperial subjectification” policies, even though they were conducted in the Japanese language, could only further isolate the indigenous territory from the social, political, and economic currents in Han Taiwan that were preparing the ground for postcolonial nationality.
zh: 在这一背景下，1930 年代的帝国臣民化政策通过新一代原住民青年团（seinendan）来推行。这些青年团的领袖是在日本统治下、在一个族群飞地中长大成人的。当总督府通过操练、阅兵、歌唱、学校、泛原住民集会、乃至最终的军事征召来动员这些青年团时，它巩固了原住民领土作为一个单独划定的实体的地位，即我所称的“二阶地理体”。因此，“帝国臣民化”政策即便以日语推行，也只能进一步把原住民领土同汉人台湾的社会、政治与经济潮流隔离开来——而那些潮流正在为后殖民时期的民族认同准备土壤。

en: During kōminka (imperial subjectification), indigenes became proficient in spoken Japanese. They hoisted Hinomaru (Japanese) flags and belted out imperial anthems with apparent gusto. Moreover, some abandoned “evil customs” such as in-home burials and face tattoos. Nonetheless, the notion that they were “becoming Japanese” overlooks an important aspect of modern citizenship: its material basis.
zh: 在皇民化（kōminka，即帝国臣民化）期间，原住民变得精通日语口语。他们升起日之丸（日本）旗，似乎兴致勃勃地高唱帝国国歌。此外，一些人放弃了“陋习”，如室内葬与纹面。尽管如此，认为他们正在“变成日本人”的看法，忽略了现代公民身份的一个重要面向：它的物质基础。

en: Unlike their neighbors, the specially administered peoples of Taiwan had never been citizens or subjects of agro-bureaucratic empires-cum-dynastic states. As “natives” practiced in the art of not being governed, most of Taiwan’s Austronesians were not accustomed to the routines of unremitting, coordinated, and surplus-generating agricultural and manufacturing toil that characterized the lot of their lowlander neighbors under Tokugawa, Qing, and Joseon rule. Looking backward, it would seem that the success of disciplinary projects such as imperial panopticism, the Taiwan Government-General’s graft of a Japanese police apparatus upon a Han Taiwanese
system, or the cultivation of national Korean and Taiwanese bourgeoisies were all premised on
processes begun before the great age of transformation.
zh: 与他们的邻居不同，台湾这些受特别行政的民族，从来不曾是实行农业官僚统治的王朝帝国的公民或臣民。作为熟谙“不被统治的艺术”的“土著”，台湾大多数南岛语族并不习惯日复一日地有组织地从事能够生产剩余的农业和制造业劳动——而那正是其低地邻居在德川、清朝与朝鲜统治下的命运。回望过去，似乎诸如帝国全景敞视主义、总督府把日本警察装置嫁接到汉人台湾保甲体系之上、或培育民族性的朝鲜与台湾资产阶级等规训工程的成功，全都以一场伟大转型时代之前便已开始的长时段过程为前提。

en: Colonial rule in Han-dominated Taiwan took on a coloration of nation building in Japan, under a regime of governmentality/discipline,

whereas the indigenous territory of Taiwan was ruled under a hybrid regime of punishment and biopolitics, at least until the 1930s. However, these regimes did not operate independently but were built together, one upon the back of the other. Initially, Japanese officials thought that highlanders could be mobilized on Japan’s side against lowlanders in the colonial state’s war against armed Han resistance. Looking back at these early years, commentators considered 1895–98 to have been a “honeymoon period” of Japanese-Indigenous relations. During this interval, brokers like Kondō the Barbarian flourished as trading-post operators, land speculators, and contract employees of the state. But the debt incurred by the Taiwan Government-General to set off the “big bang” of governmentality in the plains put pressure on the inland sea of Taiwan’s camphor forests.
zh: 在汉人占主导的台湾地区，日本殖民当局实行治理术和规训，移用了日本国内建立民族国家的做法；

而台湾的原住民领土至少到 1930 年代为止，是在惩罚与生命政治的混合体制下被统治的。然而，这些体制并非独立运作，而是彼此连接地建立，一套体制依靠另一套体制提供支撑。起初，日本官员认为可以在殖民国家对抗武装汉人抵抗的战争中，动员山地居民站在日本一边对抗低地人。回望这些早年，评论者把 1895–98 年视为日本—原住民关系的“蜜月期”。在这段间隔里，像蛮人近藤（Kondō the Barbarian）这样的掮客，作为贸易站经营者、土地投机者与国家的契约雇员而兴旺。但总督府为在平原引爆治理术“大爆炸”而背负的债务，却对台湾樟脑森林这片内陆海洋施加了压力。

en: As Japanese officials were well aware, frontier violence, which began to spike in 1898, could have been reduced by simply backing the rights of indigenes vis-à-vis Japanese lumber companies and their employees. Indeed, such a policy had much to recommend itself while Japan sought allies in its war against Han guerillas. In fact, the biggest camphor merchants in Xinzhu Prefecture in the late Qing- and early Meiji-period camphor industry were Saisiyat men, most notably Ri Aguai. Some indigenes were more than willing to sell camphor—the resource so ardently coveted by Japan’s state builders and merchants—to outsiders for monetary gain.

But the state could not exercise regulatory functions to control the volume or quality of camphor under “middle ground” or “contact zone” conditions. State planners wanted to standardize quality, regulate output, and project estimated profits from its monopoly bureau for annual budgetary purposes.

However, unlike in the plains, where smallholders and some merchants, as well as scholars, could be co-opted to provide the means for igniting the motor of disciplinary rule, the Japanese found few property holders to make a parallel class alliance in the highlands. With this crucial element missing, the Japanese state pressed forward in its efforts to make the Aborigine Territory into a state space with a series of punitive expeditions and economic embargoes.
zh: 正如日本官员所熟知的，1898 年开始激增的边疆暴力，本可通过在原住民与日本伐木公司及其雇员发生冲突时保障原住民的权利来减少。的确，当日本在对抗汉人游击队的战争中寻求盟友时，这样一种政策大有可取之处。事实上，清末及日治初年新竹厅最大的樟脑商人是赛夏人，最著名的是日阿拐。一些原住民非常乐意把樟脑——这个被日本国家建构者与商人如此热切觊觎的资源——卖给外部人以换取金钱收益。
但在“中间地带”或“接触地带”条件下，国家无法行使管制职能来控制樟脑的数量或质量。国家规划者想要标准化质量、管制产量，并估算专卖机构的利润，以便编制年度预算。
然而，与平原不同——那里的小自耕农、一些商人以及学者可以被收编，以提供点燃规训统治引擎的手段——日本人在高山地区找不到多少财产持有者来缔结一个平行的阶级联盟。由于缺失这一关键要素，日本国家以一系列惩罚性远征与经济封锁，奋力推进把蕃地变成国家空间的努力。

en: Sediq, Atayal, and Truku settlements surrendered their arms en masse and were at times relocated to valleys within reach of the police apparatus. After establishing this beachhead, the Japanese state embarked on a series of cartographic and infrastructural projects to make the indigenous territory legible to the state. But as Matsuoka Tadasu has demonstrated,

the post-1915 Japanese state balked, in a sense, by not following up its military victories with policies of reterritorialization that would have rendered the non-Han spaces of upland Taiwan indistinct from the rest of the island colony. Legible, yes, but subject to modern discipline—not quite.
zh: 赛德克、泰雅与德路固的聚落大规模缴械，有时被迁到警察装置触及范围内的谷地。在建立这一立足点之后，日本国家着手一系列制图与基础设施工程，以使原住民领土对国家而言清晰可读。但正如松冈达（Matsuoka Tadasu）所展示的，
1915 年后的日本国家在某种意义上退缩了：它没有以再领土化政策来跟进其军事胜利——那种政策本会使台湾山地的非汉人空间与岛屿殖民地的其余部分无从区分。国家固然能看清这片领土，却还不能以现代规训治理它。

en: To restate the main argument: national and indigenous political formations are homologous, historically linked, and symbiotic. Modern state building in the age of high-velocity capitalism entailed heavy governmental outlays to create commensuritized sociopolitical formations for sustaining the timely circulation of information, goods, and people, all under the pressure of international competition. In the emergent international system, at least ideally, one national geobody’s sovereignty ended where another began. The indigenous geobody was distinctive. As an administered territory defined by its exteriority to the full array of citizen-making projects associated with governmental and disciplinary tactics, the indigenous geobody was a “second-order geobody.” It was discrete and bounded, and it took on the formal properties of a geobody. Instead of achieving national sovereignty, however, it remains a subunit of a first-order geobody, the arena of discipline- and citizen-making projects in the age of global transformation.
zh: 重申主要论点：民族国家与原住民族的政治建构具有相近结构，在历史上相互联结、共生发展。高速资本主义时代的现代国家建构，需要沉重的治理术开支，以创造可按共同尺度比较、协调的社会政治形态，来维系信息、货物与人员的及时流通，而这一切都处在国际竞争的压力之下。在新兴的国际体系中，至少理想上，一个民族地理体的主权止于另一个开始之处。原住民地理体则与众不同。作为一片被行政管理的领土，其界定在于它处于治理术和规训所依赖的整套公民塑造工程之外，原住民地理体是一个“二阶地理体”。它是离散而有界的，并具备地理体的形式属性。然而，它并未达成民族主权，而仍是一个一阶地理体的次级单位——一阶地理体是全球转型时代规训与公民制作工程的角力场。

en: In Taiwan under Japanese rule, the virtuous circle of governmentality that is presupposed by legal centralism reached its geographic limit at the boundary of the Aborigine Territory. Therefore, Taiwan’s second-order geobody can be considered the ethnogeographic expression of the Japanese regime’s aspirations to master a territory just beyond its grasp. A first-order geobody describes a spatially configured unit of administration within which a mixture of Foucauldian discipline and Gramscian hegemony produces more or less self-actuating populations who surrender revenues to central authorities over and above the cost of funding myriad projects in governmentality. Such policies, programs, and installations underwrite the accumulation of capital, and its diversion to state coffers, at rates sufficient to balance accounts as calculated in annual government reports. Second-order geobodies are found at the extremities of empire, where various combinations of local resistance, rugged terrain, sparse population, and other factors rule out the creation of revenue-neutral regimes of governmentality. Although not brought within the fold of governmentality, the second-order geobodies were nonetheless constituted as objects of accounting, surveillance, and biopolitical ministration because the modern international system—unlike the interdynastic order it displaced—did not allow for ungoverned territories to exist “beyond the pale.”
zh: 在日本统治下的台湾，法律中心主义所预设的治理术良性循环，在蕃地的边界处达到了它的地理极限。因此，台湾的二阶地理体可被视为日本政权那种抱负的族群地理表达——它渴望掌控一片恰恰超出其掌控的领土。一阶地理体指一个按空间组织的行政单位，在其中，福柯式规训与葛兰西式霸权的混合，使民众在一定程度上主动按制度行事，由此向中央当局缴纳的款项超过各项治理工程的开支。此类政策、方案与设施为资本积累及其向国库的转移提供支撑，积累与划拨的规模足以让年度政府报告中的账目保持平衡。二阶地理体见于帝国的末端，那里地方抵抗、崎岖地形、稀疏人口及其他因素的各种组合，排除了创建收支平衡的治理术体制的可能。尽管未被纳入治理术的怀抱，二阶地理体却仍被构造为核算、监视与生命政治照拂的对象，因为现代国际体系——不同于它所取代的王朝间秩序——不允许未受治理的领土存在于“化外”。

en: This innovation confirms Charles Hirschman’s hypothesis that modern racial epistemology had a hand in hardening the once porous occupationally and confessionally defined sociopolitical boundaries that characterized the early-modern world. As was the case in colonial Malaysia, the racializing process in colonized Taiwan employed circular logic. In each colony, so-called Malays (indigenes) were distinguished by their putative incapacity to participate in a modern, capitalist economic system, with all of its risks and benefits. Thus, Malays were placed under “special administration” and deprived of any chance to participate in a modern, capitalist economic system.
TGG officials asked: Did villagers have written deeds to their lands? Did they grow irrigated (surplus) rice? Could they honor contracts? If the answer was “no,” then they were Malays.
zh: 这一创新证实了查尔斯·赫希曼（Charles Hirschman）的假说：近代早期世界按职业与宗教信仰划界，界线尚可跨越，现代种族知识则促使这些社会政治边界变得更加僵固。与殖民马来亚的情形一样，被殖民台湾的种族化过程运用了循环逻辑。在每个殖民地，所谓马来人（原住民）都以其据称无力参与一个现代资本主义经济体系（连同其全部风险与收益）而被区别出来。于是，马来人被置于“特别行政”之下，并被剥夺了任何参与现代资本主义经济体系的机会。
总督府官员问道：村民对其土地有无书面权状？他们是否种植水田稻米（并有剩余产出）？他们能否履约？如果答案是“否”，那么他们就是马来人。

en: On the one hand, Japanese men on the spot defined race by recourse to stereotypes and institutions disconnected from the craniometry and anthropometry that stood at the foundations of scientific racism. Nonetheless, at the back of the Malay label was a large corpus of Japanese race science. This bundle of scientistic ethnic maps, tables, photographs, and assessments of character mostly went ignored by policy makers in the early decades of Japanese rule. Yet it reemerged in the 1920s as the substrate for further elaboration, and it has been energetically revived in post–martial law Taiwan since the 1990s.
zh: 一方面，在台湾当地办事的日本人诉诸刻板印象与制度来界定种族，而这些同奠定科学种族主义基础的颅骨测量与人体测量并无关联。尽管如此，在“马来人”标签背后，是一大套日本种族科学。这一整套科学主义的族群地图、表格、照片与性格评估，在日本统治的最初几十年里大多被政策制定者忽视。然而它在 1920 年代重新浮现，作为进一步阐发的基底，并自 1990 年代以来在解严后的台湾重新受到重视。

en: The classificatory work of three men in particular has drawn sustained attention from scholars of Japanese rule in Taiwan and of the history of anthropology in Japan’s empire. They will play important roles in this study, as well. These three pioneering government ethnologists—Torii Ryūzō (1870–1953), Inō Kanori (1867–1925), and Mori Ushinosuke (1877–1926)—completed their most celebrated work during the first two decades of colonial rule, between 1895 and 1915. Methodologically, they arrayed various word lists, artifacts of material life, and elements of intangible culture into the tabular form that characterized fin-de-siècle anthropology’s comparative method. Based on this data, they sorted Taiwan’s diverse upland settlements into a nine-tribe schema. These tribes were represented as commensurate units juxtaposed like nation-states on a Mercator-projection map.
zh: 尤其有三个人的分类工作，持续吸引了研究日本在台统治、以及日本帝国人类学史的学者的注意。他们在本研究中也将扮演重要角色。这三位开创性的政府民族学家——鸟居龙藏（1870–1953）、伊能嘉矩（1867–1925）、森丑之助（1877–1926）——在殖民统治的头二十年、即 1895 至 1915 年间完成了他们最负盛名的工作。在方法上，他们把各种词表、物质生活的器物与非物质文化的要素，排列成那种表征世纪末人类学比较方法的表格形式。基于这些数据，他们把台湾多样的山地聚落归入九个族群类别。这些部落被表征为可通约的单位，像民族国家一样并置在一幅墨卡托投影地图上。

en: Reflecting their engagement with transnational currents in the young science of ethnology, these men were dissenters from the crudest forms of polygenetist racism that informed evolutionary anthropology. Rather, like Franz Boas and kindred spirits in England and Germany, these men advocated the worth and importance of nonliterate, small-scale societies as objects of study and subjects of history. To be sure, like Boas himself, they were self-assured in their superiority as members of industrial, urbanized societies. They neither aimed for nor achieved the Malinowskian ideal of empathy or access to the interior lives of members of the societies who were the objects of their taxonomic labors. As survey ethnologists, however, they were much more concerned about specificity, particularity, and the well-being of the peoples they studied than armchair ethnologists who did not concern themselves with face-to-face encounters. Reflecting their complicated relationship to the politics of conquest and ethnogenesis, their work was too fine-grained in some regards, and too abstract in others, to appear immediately useful to administrators in the early decades of colonial rule.
zh: 这些人深受新兴民族学的跨国思潮影响，反对进化论人类学所依据的多源论种族主义最粗陋的形式。毋宁说，像弗朗茨·博厄斯（Franz Boas）及英、德的同道一样，这些人主张无文字的小型社会作为研究对象与历史主体的价值与重要性。诚然，像博厄斯本人一样，他们作为工业化、城市化社会的成员，对自身优越性自信满满。他们既未追求、也未达到马林诺夫斯基式的理想，即设身处地理解研究对象，走进那些被他们分类的人群的内在生活。然而，作为调查民族学家，他们比那些不关心面对面接触的书斋民族学家，远为关注其所研究民族的具体性、特殊性与福祉。反映出他们与征服政治及族群生成的复杂关系，他们的工作在某些方面过于细密、在另一些方面又过于抽象，以致在殖民统治最初几十年里显得对行政者并无直接用处。

en: However, on the heels of Governor-General Sakuma’s campaign against the northern tribes, which ended in 1915, several trends conspired to put the latently pluralist conception of Taiwan devised by Torii, Inō, and Mori on a permanent footing, one that lasts to this day.

First, reflecting the post–World War I ethos of cultural appraisal (which was eclipsing racist denigration) that accompanied the Wilsonian moment, the new apostles of folklore and ethnic authenticity portrayed themselves as the stewards of territory inhabited by the non-Han Malayans.
This operation figuratively swept the landscape of Chinese claims to prior occupation. Moreover, an ethnic tourism trade emerged in Taiwan’s highlands in the 1920s.
Its myriad graphic and material products were organized around the ethnic-pluralist model and institutionalized a view of indigenous Taiwan that rendered it a culture garden (see chapter 4).
zh: 然而，紧随总督佐久间针对北部部落、于 1915 年结束的战役之后，几股趋势共同作用，使鸟居、伊能和森那套蕴含多元主义的台湾观得到巩固，并延续至今。
首先，反映出伴随威尔逊时刻而来的一战后文化赏识风气（它正使种族主义贬抑黯然失色），民俗与族群本真性的新使徒们把自己描绘为非汉人马来族所居领土的守护者。
这一操作在象征意义上从这片土地的象征表述中抹去了汉人关于自己曾先行占居的主张。此外，1920 年代台湾山地兴起了一种族群旅游贸易。
其无数的图像与物质产品围绕族群多元主义模型组织起来，并把一种使原住民台湾成为文化花园的观点制度化（见第 4 章）。

en: To put these developments into global context, we recall that Bayly’s narrative of displacement, depopulation, and dispossession ends in 1914 on a cautious note: he did not write off the small-scale societies that Eric Wolf once termed the “peoples without history.” Bayly noted that indigenous resilience and creativity, the new human science of anthropology, a market for primitivist art in the metropole, and a growing revulsion to settler avarice in the mother countries had prevented the natives from becoming extinct. Turned on their heads, the forces Bayly regards as brakes on the extermination of natives can be reconceptualized as a seedbed for the creation of
zh: 为把这些发展置于全球语境，我们回想贝利关于流离、人口减少与剥夺的叙事，写到1914年，以审慎的判断收尾：他并未把埃里克·沃尔夫曾称为“没有历史的民族”的小型社会一笔勾销。贝利指出，原住民的韧性与创造力、人类学这门新的人文科学、帝国本土对原始主义艺术的需求、以及母国对定居者贪欲日益增长的厌恶，阻止了土著灭绝。换一个角度看，贝利用以解释土著何以存续的这些力量，也是催生原住民主义的条件。

en: Anthropologist Ronald Niezen defines indigenism as the movement of First Nations and indigenous peoples to secure political rights, or even national self-determination, based on claims to primordial and prior ties to particular territories. Niezen has observed that indigenism has flourished with the
of international society after World War II. He argues that the First Nations or indigenous peoples of the world, who number some “three hundred million people from four thousand distinct societies,”

are now a self-conscious, transnational force, whose current methods of rights articulation, preservation, and reclamation would have been scarcely imaginable in the prewar era. One of this book’s tasks is to reconcile the corrosive effects of nation building and capitalism on the natives during the global transformation that left the world with “four to eight million” people existing on the margins of expanding states circa 1900 and the rise of indigenous peoples as an integral component of international society in the current dispensation.
zh: 人类学家罗纳德·尼曾（Ronald Niezen）把原住民主义界定为第一民族与原住民基于对特定领土的原初且先在联系的主张，去争取政治权利、乃至民族自决的运动。尼曾观察到，原住民主义随着二战后国际社会的强化而兴盛。他论证，世界上那些第一民族或原住民——约“来自四千个不同社会的三亿人口”
——如今是一股自觉的跨国力量，其如今申明、维护和争取恢复权利的方式，在战前时代几乎不可想象。本书的任务之一，是调和以下两者：一方面，全球转型期间民族建构与资本主义对土著的腐蚀效应，使世界在约 1900 年只剩下“四百万到八百万”人存在于扩张国家的边缘；另一方面，在当前安排下，原住民作为国际社会一个不可或缺的组成部分而崛起。

en: In this case study of Taiwan under Japanese colonial rule, the period that separates Bayly’s narrative of decline and Niezen’s assertion of interstate system / First Nations symbiosis—1915 to 1945—brackets the years when central administrators in Taipei institutionalized and culturally invested the second-order geobodies that comprise Taiwan’s indigenous territory. Prasenjit Duara writes that during the interwar period, Wilsonian notions of ethnic self-determination, combined with strains of historical pessimism in the West, blunted the impulse to conquer new colonies outright or to expand state borders at the expense of natives. Duara argues that a new, globally circulating “symbolic regime of authenticity” based political legitimacy on primordial ties to territory instead of on the rights of the conqueror to rule the conquered. Thus, “cultural rule” in Korea after 1919 and Japan’s insistence that Manchukuo be ruled as a de jure nation-state rather than as a colony were consonant with the Wilsonian outlook. In both cases, Japanese ideologues anchored claims to legitimacy in the language of a brand of stewardship that was exercised in the name of the authentic nation/nationals of each dependency.
zh: 在这个日本殖民统治下台湾的案例研究中，分隔贝利的衰落叙事与尼曾关于国家间体系/第一民族共生之断言的那段时期——1915 至 1945 年——正是台北的中央行政当局将构成台湾原住民领土的各个二阶地理体制度化，并为其文化活动投入资源的时期。杜赞奇（Prasenjit Duara）写道，两次大战之间，威尔逊式的族群自决观念，与西方种种历史悲观主义思潮相结合，钝化了直接征服新殖民地、或以土著为代价扩展国家边界的冲动。杜赞奇论证，一种新的、全球流通的“本真性的象征体制”，把政治合法性建立在人群与领土的原初联系之上，而非建立在征服者统治被征服者的权利之上。因此，1919 年后朝鲜的“文化统治”，以及日本坚持满洲国应作为一个法理上的民族国家而非殖民地来统治，都与威尔逊式观点相合。在这两个案例中，日本意识形态家把合法性主张锚定在一种守护话语之中——这种守护以每个属地的本真民族/国民的名义行使。

en: In Taiwan, the discourse on sovereignty and authenticity dovetailed with an ethnic tourism trade that ennobled former “savage headhunters” as ethnic groups worthy of study, preservation, and even emulation. Indigenous artists, tourism industry workers, native informants, and politicians responded to those opportunities by producing the artifacts, icons, and performances that put flesh on the administrative-academic skeleton of territorially defined ethnic difference.

Under conditions of economic and physical isolation, coupled with cultural investment, the ungoverned peripheries of yore became the indigenous territories of today—now imagined as timeless, authentic, and buffered from the flow of world history.
zh: 在台湾，关于主权与本真性的话语，同一种族群旅游贸易相互契合；这种贸易把昔日的“野蛮猎首者”尊为值得研究、保存乃至效仿的族群。原住民艺术家、旅游业从业者、提供资料的当地原住民与政客回应这些机会，生产出器物、图标与表演，让行政部门和学界按领土划分族群的框架有了具体可见的内容。
在经济与物理隔离、加上文化投资的条件下，昔日未受治理的边缘变成了今日的原住民领土——如今被想象为超越时代、保持本真，仿佛未受世界历史进程的冲击。

en: Acknowledging that historical forces created indigenous peoples is not the same thing as claiming that indigenous claims for rights recovery in land, resources, or human rights rest on invented traditions and are thus hollow. As Arif Dirlik put it, “[a] critique of “cultural essentialism” that offers no articulated means to distinguish between the essentialism of indigenous ideology, and the essentialism of a Confucian revival or [political scientist Samuel] Huntington’s vision of war among civilizations, may be methodologically justifiable; but it is, to say the least, morally irresponsible and politically obscene. Indigenous claims to identity are very much tied in with a desperate concern for survival; not in a “metaphorical” but in a very material sense.”
zh: 承认是历史力量创造了原住民，并不等于声称原住民要求恢复土地权、资源权或人权的主张建立在被发明的传统之上、因而是空洞的。正如阿里夫·德里克（Arif Dirlik）所言，“一种对‘文化本质主义’的批判，若不能提出明确的手段来区分原住民意识形态的本质主义、与儒学复兴或[政治学家塞缪尔·]亨廷顿关于文明间战争的愿景的本质主义，那它或许在方法上站得住脚；但至少可以说，它在道德上不负责任、在政治上令人反感。原住民对身份的主张，与一种对生存的绝望关切紧密相连；不是在‘隐喻’意义上，而是在非常物质的意义上。”

en: The example of the Saisiyat group in northern Taiwan provides a counterweight to breezy notions that indigenous peoples themselves, as self-defined collectivities, were

by colonialist discourse or urban metropolitan longings. While the notion that their homeland is circumscribed by a fixed boundary line populated by bearers of a unique cultural ensemble is indeed a colonial invention, Qing-period records indicate that Saisiyat peoples identified themselves as Saisiyat before Japanese colonization. Moreover, they have retained and defended a sense of corporate identity without recourse to projected or reified cultural markers as core elements of identity. At the same time, colonial-period photographs, artifacts, and documents, as material objects, have—to use Hu Chia-yu’s apt phrase—“enlivened” the past and served as touchstones for perseverance in the face of settler encroachment and institutionalized racism. Hu’s invocation of Marshall Sahlins reinforces Dirlik’s point and bears repeating: “The awareness of indigenous culture as a value to be lived and defended is not just a simple and nostalgic desire for the fetishized repositories of a pristine identity, but signifies the demand of them for their own space within the world cultural order, and recognizes their existence in the context of national or international threats.”
zh: 台湾北部赛夏群的例子，为那种轻率的看法提供了一个制衡——即认为原住民本身作为自我界定的集体，是被殖民主义话语或都市都城的渴望所发明的。虽然认为其家园由一条固定界线圈定，界内居民共同承载一套独特文化，这的确是一项殖民发明，但清代记录表明，赛夏人在日本殖民之前就已把自己认同为赛夏人。此外，他们保留并捍卫了一种群体身份感，而无须诉诸被投射或被物化的文化标志作为身份的核心要素。与此同时，殖民时期的照片、器物与文件作为物质对象，已经——用胡家瑜（Hu Chia-yu）的贴切说法——“激活”了过去，并充当了在定居者蚕食与制度化种族主义面前坚持下去的试金石。胡对马歇尔·萨林斯（Marshall Sahlins）的援引强化了德里克的论点，值得重申：“认识到原住民文化有其价值，值得在生活中遵循和捍卫，并不只是对一种原初身份被拜物化库藏的简单而怀旧的渴望，而是意味着他们要求在世界文化秩序中拥有自己的空间，并承认他们在民族或国际威胁语境中的存在。”

en: The goal of this book is to think through the processes and structures in world history that coproduced nation-states and indigenous peoples. It is less about the invention of tradition among indigenous peoples than it is about the incomplete consolidation of legal centralism characteristic of state building in the era of competitive imperialism and high-velocity capitalism. The world that was obliterated by the twin forces of capitalism and nationalism was not that of the natives but rather that of the in-between spaces of ambiguous sovereignty, the buffer zones at the margins or interstices of centrally administered, surplus-extracting dynastic and nation-states. In this niche, chiefs, interpreters, trading-post operators, trackers, headmen, and professional border crossers brokered the coexistence of political autonomy and economic interdependence during the
zh: 本书的目标，是透彻思考世界历史中促成民族国家与原住民族共同形成的过程与结构。它较少关乎原住民中被发明的传统，而更多关乎法律中心主义那种不完整的巩固——那是竞争性帝国主义与高速资本主义时代国家建构的特征。被资本主义与民族主义这两股力量抹除的世界，不是土著的世界，而是那些主权暧昧的中间空间的世界，是中央直接管理、抽取剩余的王朝国家与民族国家边缘或缝隙处的缓冲地带。在这些中间地带，酋长、通事、贸易站经营者、追踪向导、头人与职业越界者，在全球转型期间居间促成了政治自主与经济相互依赖的共存。

en: As it turns out, the success or failure of projects to instantiate governmentality in Taiwan largely hinged upon whether or not a district or area had fallen under Qing administration. If this case study has broader applicability, the disciplined social fields considered normative in our models of international relations may, in fact, be products of

processes that spanned successive empires. This finding suggests that today’s international order is premised on sociological models that are relevant to a minority of the earth’s population. Moreover, it suggests that bringing historically undisciplined populations within the ken of international society (“nation building”) is probably beyond the means or will of any state that possesses the surplus wealth to pull it off. This is because such projects exhaust the patience of citizenries who must foot the bill, and because governments that ignore the centripetal pull of popular sentiment by definition lack the stability and resources to complete long-term projects for exporting discipline beyond their own borders.
zh: 结果表明，在台湾确立治理术的工程之成败，很大程度上取决于一个地区或区域是否曾落入清朝行政之下。如果这个案例研究有更广的适用性，那么在我们国际关系模型中被视为规范的那些受规训的社会场域，事实上可能是横跨相继帝国的长时段过程的产物。这一发现表明，今日的国际秩序建立在只适用于全球少部分人口的社会学模型之上。此外，它还表明，把历史上未受规训的人口纳入国际社会的规范秩序（“民族建构”），很可能超出任何拥有足以成事之剩余财富的国家的能力或意愿。这是因为此类工程耗尽了必须买单的公民群体的耐心，也因为那些无视民众情感向心拉力的政府，按定义就缺乏稳定与资源去完成把规训输出到自身边界之外的长期工程。

en: This introduction has argued that the process Ronald Niezen dubs “indigenization” and the phenomenon James Clifford terms “Indigènitude” are historical concomitants of nation building during the era of high imperialism (1870–1914). Anthropologists and sociologists consider the decades following 1960 to be the incubation period for the global indigenism movement. Indigenism, in their view, rests upon an infrastructure of interstate coordination anchored in UN human-rights conventions, transregional NGO activity, and democratically sanctioned political protest. By looking for the origins of indigenism in the late nineteenth century, I have argued that seemingly disparate formations—a supra-state, nation-states, and stateless peoples—emerged as contemporaneous formations. The case study of Taiwan under Japanese rule suggests that nationality, internationalism, and indigenism were mutually constituted, rather than sequentially occurring phenomena.
zh: 本导论论证，罗纳德·尼曾称为“原住民化”的过程、与詹姆斯·克利福德（James Clifford）称为“原住民性”（Indigènitude）的现象，是帝国主义鼎盛时期（1870–1914）民族建构的历史伴生物。人类学家与社会学家把 1960 年之后的几十年视为全球原住民主义运动的孵化期。在他们看来，原住民主义建立在一套国家间协调的基础设施之上，这套设施锚定于联合国人权公约、跨区域非政府组织活动、以及经民主认可的政治抗议。通过到十九世纪晚期去寻找原住民主义的起源，我论证了那些看似迥异的形态——超越单个国家的秩序、诸民族国家以及无国家的民族——是作为同时代的形态浮现的。日本统治下台湾的案例研究表明，民族身份、国际主义与原住民主义是在彼此作用中形成的，而非依次发生的现象。

en: Chapter 1 of this study begins with the murders of fifty-four shipwrecked Okinawans on Taiwan’s Hengchun Peninsula. This cause célèbre put the opposing logics of the dynastic and international systems on a collision course. Hengchun’s mountain ranges were resistant to rule from a distance under the Qing, hindering the recovery of remains and the punishment of the alleged killers. The first part of chapter 1 explains how the lack of horizontal integration between the Hengchun Peninsula and the Qing Empire necessitated “wet diplomacy.” This mode of interaction stressed particularistic, emotionally charged attachments requiring periodical renewal in the absence of administrators, courts, and policemen. To eradicate this obstacle to efficient resource management, which survived the transfer of sovereignty from the Qing to Japan in 1895, the colonial government built armed bunkers, relay stations, and guard posts along a scorched-earth trail known as the aiyūsen to enclose the Atayal settlements of northern Taiwan. From 1903 through 1915, government forces extended the barrier and then marched it inward. The Taiwan Indigenous Peoples, as a modern political-cultural formation, emerged from the ruins of these scorched-earth campaigns as a disarmed, geographically isolated, and dispossessed minority population.
zh: 本研究第 1 章从五十四名因船只失事而遇险的冲绳人在台湾恒春半岛被杀开始。这一轰动一时的案件，使王朝体系与国际体系这两种对立的逻辑迎头相撞。恒春的山脉在清朝统治下抗拒来自远方的治理，阻碍了遗骸的收殓与对据称凶手的惩罚。第 1 章第一部分解释，恒春半岛与清帝国之间横向整合的缺乏，如何使“湿外交”成为必需。这种互动模式强调建立在具体人际关系上、带有强烈情感的纽带，在缺乏行政官、法院与警察的情况下需要定期更新。为铲除这一高效资源管理的障碍——它在 1895 年主权从清转移到日本后依然存续——殖民政府沿着一条称为隘勇线（aiyūsen）的焦土小径，修建武装碉堡、中继站与哨所，以圈围台湾北部的泰雅聚落。从 1903 到 1915 年，政府军延伸这道屏障，然后把它向内推进。台湾原住民作为一个现代政治—文化形态，从这些焦土战役的废墟中浮现，成为一个被解除武装、在地理上受到隔离、失去原有资源的少数群体。

en: Chapter 2 advances the argument that linguistic diversity occasioned institutional creativity and strategic frustration for colonialists in Taiwan. It examines state-led efforts to yoke an unruly Qing periphery to a centralized administration through its language and education policies. In Taiwan, administrators required methods to govern a patchwork of Chinese- and Austronesian-language-speaking populations. Commercial interdependency between the island’s varied social formations spawned more organic solutions to the problem of cross-border communications, as well. Top-down, centrally installed measures, such as language training for colonizers or the colonized, were most amenable to administrative cohesion. However, formal language instruction was not scalable, due to cost constraints. Bottom-up arrangements, such as intersocietal adoption and marriage-centered alliance, were cost-effective but less answerable to central command. The Japanese state ultimately opted for intermarriages as a strategy—a holdover from Qing times. This policy came up short because it fostered identification with particular local power structures. It also allowed colonists to establish kin-ordered bases of authority independent of their bureaucratic chains of command. The political marriages, therefore, contradicted the more general colony-wide impulse to homogenize bureaucratic, legal, and economic space, and they led to intelligence failures and discontent among the ruled and even to the Wushe Rebellion of 1930.
zh: 第 2 章推进这一论点：语言多样性为台湾的殖民者带来了制度创造力与战略挫败。它考察国家主导的、通过语言与教育政策把难以管束的旧清治边地纳入中央行政体制的努力。在台湾，行政者需要方法来治理一片由汉语与南岛语人口拼凑而成的格局。岛上多样社会形态之间的商业相互依赖，也催生了对跨界沟通问题更为有机的解决方案。自上而下、由中央部署的措施，例如对殖民者或被殖民者的语言训练，最有利于行政凝聚。然而，正规语言教学因成本约束而无法规模化。自下而上的安排，例如族际收养与以婚姻为中心的联盟，成本效益高，却较难对中央号令负责。日本国家最终选择通婚作为策略——这是清代遗留的做法。这一政策未能奏效，因为它培育了对特定地方权力结构的认同。它还允许殖民者建立独立于其官僚指挥链的、按亲属秩序组织的权威基础。因此，政治婚姻与那种更一般的、全殖民地范围内同质化官僚、法律与经济空间的冲动相矛盾，并导致情报失败与被统治者的不满，乃至 1930 年的雾社起义。

en: The next chapter demonstrates how gifts performed multiple functions in the borderland economy of Qing-period and Japanese-ruled Taiwan. Travelers brought offerings to the mountainous hinterland to pay for services rendered or expectations of future assistance. In addition, the presentations of gifts were occasions for recording the emotional states of recipients and for gauging the dispositions of little-known peoples as either “greedy,” “honest,” or “uncorrupted.” Gifts also fostered trade dependency among indigenes. As the Taiwan Government-General intensified resource extraction from camphor forests in the 1900s, it regulated gift giving as an arm of policy, to reform indigenous mores or to reward and punish highlanders. One class of these gifts, those involving dyed red thread or cloth, took on additional meaning, as these materials were disassembled and reassembled into “traditional” Atayal textiles. These were either consumed locally or reexported to trading posts, anthropologists, curators, and tourists. In this last guise, Atayal red-dyed textiles became exhibits in discourses on authenticity, progress, and primitivism. By tracking the uses of textiles across these many domains, chapter 3 illustrates the productive, though problematic, interdependence of indigenes, settlers, and metropolitans in the production of colonial modernity and global indigenism.
zh: 下一章展示礼物如何在清代与日本统治下台湾的边疆经济中履行多重功能。旅行者带着馈赠进入山地腹地，作为答谢已得到的帮助或换取日后协助的报偿。此外，赠礼的场合也是记录受礼者情绪状态、并把那些鲜为人知民族的性情衡量为“贪婪”“诚实”或“未受腐蚀”的时机。礼物还在原住民中培育了贸易依赖。当总督府在 1900 年代加强对樟脑森林的资源抽取时，它规制赠礼，把它用作政策手段，以改革原住民习俗或奖惩高山族。这些礼物中的一类——涉及染红的线或布的那些——获得了额外意义，因为这些材料被拆解并重新组装成“传统”泰雅织物。它们要么在当地消费，要么再流向贸易站、人类学家、策展人和游客。在这最后一种形态中，泰雅红染织物成为关于本真性、进步与原始主义话语中的展品。通过追踪织物在这诸多领域中的用途，第 3 章例示了原住民、定居者与都城人在殖民现代性与全球原住民主义的生产中那种富有生产性、却问题重重的相互依赖。

en: Chapter 4 examines a battery of twentieth-century Japanese official, academic, and commercial publications about Taiwan indigenes. These artifacts deployed texts, pictures, and maps to manufacture a “large reservoir of cultural imaginaries”

that have reemerged as reference points and resources for the indigenous renaissance in the twenty-first century. In what began as a quest to wrest resources, impose administrative order, and promote immigration to an erstwhile Qing borderland in the late 1890s and 1900s, Japan’s colonial administration, tourism industry, and scholarly apparatus, by the 1930s, had completed numerous projects in ethnic typification, geobody construction, and racialization to institutionalize indigeneity in Taiwan. This concluding chapter analyzes these three interrelated processes to demonstrate how the increased intensity of resource extraction in colonial Taiwan intersected with historical trends in reprographic technology and new forms of state making to ethnically pluralize the island’s non-Han populations as second-order geobodies.
zh: 第 4 章考察一批二十世纪日本关于台湾原住民的官方、学术与商业出版物。这些出版物运用文字、图像和地图，制造出一个“巨大的文化想象库”

，它在二十一世纪重新浮现，成为原住民复兴的参照点与资源。这一切始于 1890 年代晚期与 1900 年代一场夺取资源、强加行政秩序、并促进向昔日清朝边疆移民的追求；到 1930 年代，日本的殖民行政、旅游业与学术装置已完成大量族群类型化、地理体建构与种族化工程，以把台湾的原住民性制度化。这一收尾章分析这三个相互关联的过程，以展示殖民台湾资源抽取强度的增加，如何与图文复制技术的发展及建立国家的新方式相互作用，进而把岛上的非汉居民按不同族群组织进多个二阶地理体。
